thread:
marta: Found ~120 staging CI debug uploads to partner-error-bucket containing Vault transit wrappers (strings like 'vault:v1:...'). Likely debug artifacts were archived raw. Need immediate containment.

sam: Yikes. Can you post a couple object keys and one sample wrapper header (no plaintext)?

marta: keys: telemetry-ci/pr-5012/debug-20260320-0210.log, telemetry-ci/pr-5013/wrap-20260320.bin
sample: 'vault:v1:3a9f...'

devops-sre: On it: deleting matching objects now and will disable telemetry CI SA keys. Commands: aws s3 rm s3://partner-error-bucket/telemetry-ci/ --recursive --include "pr-*" && gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable KEY_ID --iam-account=telemetry-ci@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com

oncall-bot: Incident INC-2026-4488 created, sec-oncall paged.

jia: I'll pull KMS/Vault audit logs for Decrypt/Unwrap during the window and post results. If no unwraps, blast radius is limited.

sam: Plan:
- immediate deletes + SA key disable (devops-sre)
- revoke any Vault leases tied to telemetry CI (marta/devops-sre)
- rotate staging transit key: vault write -f transit/keys/staging-telemetry/rotate
- schedule rewrap of archives we control
- land CI sanitizer to block uploads containing 'vault:v1:' and tighten PutObject RBAC to partner-error-bucket

devops-sre: Deleted 121 objects and disabled 2 SA keys. Revoked 5 leases. Audit exports uploaded to gs://security-evidence/INC-2026-4488/.

jia: No Decrypt/Unwrap entries found in audit window so far. I'll continue deeper analysis and attach IP/caller details to the incident. Recommend alert for any future object upload containing substring 'vault:v1:'.

msam: Draft partner note approved: we'll say we removed artifacts, rotated the staging transit key, disabled CI keys, and are reviewing audit logs. Send after I approve final text.

marta: Checklist: [x] delete objects [x] disable SA keys [x] revoke leases [x] rotate transit key [ ] confirm no unwraps in audits (jia) [ ] push CI sanitizer & RBAC fix (devops-sre) [ ] partner notification (sam)

sam: Thanks all — will file postmortem ticket and RBAC hardening tasks. :thumbsup:
